newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-HELMER JOINS GERMAN CASUALTY LIST.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HELMER JOINS GERMAN CASUALTY LIST.

text.p: Bayern Munich defender Thomas Helmer had his gall bladder removed in an operation on Wednesday, adding another name to Germany's lengthy injury list ahead of their group nine World Cup qualifier with Portugal.
Helmer was expected to stay in hospital until Monday, making him doubtful for the Lisbon match the following Saturday.
Midfielders Thomas Haessler and Mehmet Scholl and striker Oliver Bierhoff are already out of the match because of injury.
Germany coach Berti Vogts said playmaker Andreas Moeller was also doubtful for the game and Mario Basler, just returning from an injury, might not be able to play for the full 90 minutes.
"That would mean the entire midfield could be missing," Vogts said. "There are a lot of question marks ahead of this match."
